description: Genset control: data protocol 5010 (basic visualization) over Modbus: generator, busbar and mains values, engine values, analog inputs and outputs, control bits, relay outputs and latched alarm bits
source: Woodward, easYgen-3000XT Series manual B37574 revision U (release 2.17-0), appendix 9.2.4 Protocol 5010
firmware: release 2.17-0 (the version the manual applies to)

sources.title: easYgen-3000XT Series Manual Genset Control
sources.note: appendix 9.2.4, Protocol 5010 (Basic Visualization); chapter 7.6 Modbus Protocol

notes: Modbus RTU (RS-485) and Modbus TCP. Data protocol 5010 is the default visualization protocol (parameter 3184 Modbus protocol number = 5010).
Addresses are bus addresses: the manual's Modicon address 450001 is sent as 50000. Read with function 03, in blocks of up to 128 registers.
Power, voltage and current values use the exponent registers 50001-50003 (value x 10^exponent).
Registers and bits that the manual marks for the easYgen-3500XT only are left out; internal registers are left out.
Configuration parameters are read and written one at a time at Modicon address 40000 + (parameter ID + 1), or 400000 + (ID + 1) for IDs from 10000, and are not in this map.
Written from the manufacturer's manual; not tested on a device.
